actions.action: Merge paragraph edits using causal revision histories
actions.mechanism: Merge immutable edits by stable paragraph ID; causal ancestry distinguishes replacements from concurrent versions without ranking authors.
actions.implementation: Record device/counter operation IDs, author, text, and causal parents. Exchange missing operations over the existing sync path; retain concurrent originals.
actions.check: Edit different paragraphs offline, then exchange operations in both orders. Require identical text, retained versions, and authorship.
actions.risk: Logical revision numbers alone cannot establish cross-device causality.

actions.action: Preserve deletion conflicts for explicit user resolution
actions.mechanism: A deletion is a causal tombstone, not erased storage; concurrent edits remain inspectable alongside it.
actions.implementation: Display delete-versus-edit conflicts with original text, author/device, and revision. Store resolutions referencing all reviewed versions; preserve originals until resolution.
actions.check: Delete a paragraph on one device and edit it on the other. Both reconnect orders must expose identical choices.
actions.risk: Concurrent resolutions must themselves remain conflicts, not silently overwrite.

actions.action: Separate paragraph placement from paragraph content
actions.mechanism: Independent position revisions prevent reordering from overwriting prose; concurrent moves retain explainable alternatives.
actions.implementation: Assign fractional position keys. Track moves causally by paragraph ID; deterministically select concurrent display positions by revision/device, preserving alternatives. Break placement ties by paragraph ID.
actions.check: Replay concurrent reorders plus text edits in both orders. Require identical displayed order, unchanged text, and visible move alternatives.
actions.risk: Position-key growth requires care; avoid uncoordinated offline renumbering.

actions.action: Add deterministic offline replay and convergence tests
actions.mechanism: A fixed operation history tests convergence independently of delivery order, retries, and process restarts.
actions.implementation: Seed paragraphs P/Q/R. Script independent edits, concurrent P edits, Q deletion versus editing, and reorders across 48 offline hours; replay opposite reconnect orders.
actions.check: Assert identical canonical state, retained conflicting originals and authors, visible Q conflict, and convergence after explicit resolution; repeat with duplicates and restarts.
actions.risk: Also test 500 paragraphs at 8 KB; retained histories exceed live-document bounds.
